questions.q: What do the **columns** of a 2×2 matrix $M$ tell you?
options: Where the basis vectors $\hat{\imath}$ and $\hat{\jmath}$ land
The area of the unit square
The rotation angle and the scale factor
questions.explain: $M\hat{\imath}$ is the first column and $M\hat{\jmath}$ the second; once you know them, linearity fixes the rest of the grid. The origin never moves.

questions.q: With the preset **Stretch X, Squash Y**, $M = \begin{bmatrix} 1.5 & 0 \\ 0 & 0.5 \end{bmatrix}$. Where does the point $(2, 1)$ go?
In $M = H\,R\,S$ (shear · rotation · scale), which transformation acts on a vector $x$ **first**?
options: All act at the same time, so order does not matter
questions.explain: Matrices act right-to-left: $M x = H(R(Sx))$, so the point is scaled first, then rotated, then sheared — and order matters.

questions.q: The preset **Collapse to line (Singular)** is $\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$. What does $\det(M) = 0$ mean here?
options: The plane is flipped like a mirror
The whole plane is squashed onto a line, so area becomes 0
questions.explain: Both columns point along $(1, 1)$, so every point lands on that one line: space collapses to a lower dimension and $|\det| = 0$.
